items.text: Drive seller adoption of cross border key projects, main tasks include:
Understand current cross border performance from various angles (e.g., by time period, by cluster/category, by seller type, by streaming metrics, etc.)
Analyze relevant data and set reasonable targets for different seller groups
Understand potential pain points and brainstorm solutions to close gap and ensure target achievement
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (incl. Other countries’cross border team, MKT, BI, Ops, ...) to ensure execution excellence in driving project success
Competitor survey and investigation (incl. Taobao, pingduoduo, Coupang..etc) to strategically implement defense plan
AI integration : Identify AI integration opportunities to optimize workflows and collaborate with AI engineers to develop productivity-driven AI solutions

key_values.text: 市場調查資料分析與報告撰寫、數據分析、市場趨勢分析、競品分析、提案與簡報技巧、AI

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
【經驗條件】
1. (必要條件) Practical Experience with AI Tools: Proficient in at least one AI tool (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney) and can use prompts to solve practical problems
2. Fluent in English speaking and writing
3. Strong ownership mindset in project management; comfortable with intense project pace and result delivery in a timely manner
【加分條件】
1. 資管/資工/統計/工管/管理科學系畢業尤佳
2. 具備電商相關知識，適應電商快速步調尤佳
3. 有AI自動化工具串接經驗：熟悉 Make.com、Zapier或Python等自動化串接工具，能建立AI工作流程尤佳
